overall_intent: A useful Clockpunk departure indicator, its reference-guided attendant and an arriving real boat form one inhabited travel moment. Preserve actual requester meaning and face/hair reference scope; explore only restrained local structural, contact and depth refinements at the saved creativity one. Detailed mechanism and canal staging remain agent-owned experimental choices.

object_structure.reason: The selected photograph depends on readable joined parts of one useful machine, rather than isolated decorative gear shapes.
object_structure.expressive_goal: Let the departure indicator read as an intelligible made object whose stored power, transmission and output have visible owners and joints.
observable_targets: Meshing gear train and pinion/rack join
owner_relations: The cord belongs to the suspended drive weight and wraps the drum.
The gear train belongs to the departure-table and reaches the carriage output.
required_constraints: Preserve the Clockpunk topic and the reference-guided subject.
The appearance-reference property belongs to main_person, so structural ideas for the separate table cannot rewrite the person's face or hair.
preserved_choices: Prefer the baseline weight-driven departure-table for this agent-owned experimental comparison.
Keep visible useful operation rather than merely a clock face.
open_scope: Local construction, part separation and material arrangement of the independently authored table may be refined.
No source grants missing native owners or promotes these experimental parts into requester mechanics.
object_structure.role_focus: A hand-built weight-driven departure indicator with a traceable cord-to-drum drive, contacting gear teeth and pinion-to-rack output carrying a small route marker; seek coherent visible part connections that make useful mechanical construction legible.
object_structure.scene_context: A fictional canal attendant has finished winding the table as a passenger boat approaches. The person and open mechanism share one clear view; modest local refinement at creativity one.

grounds.quote: A suspended weight and taut cord visibly connect to the exposed drum and touching gear train.
A terminal pinion visibly engages the rack carrying the brass boat marker beneath its route line.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This role concerns the table's non-anatomical geometry and joined parts. It does not ask for a new actor, a different genre, inferred engineering certification or changes to reference appearance.

contact_point.reason: The working moment needs plausible human contact that leaves the machine readable.
contact_point.expressive_goal: Show quiet competence through a detached key in one hand and light support on the table frame.
observable_targets: Right-hand grip on detached winding key at hip
Left palm contacting the outer oak frame
Clear space between arms and transmission
owner_relations: Both hands belong to the same attendant.
The key is separated from its winding arbor.
The opposite palm touches the outer support frame rather than a moving gear.
required_constraints: Preserve the invented reference-guided subject and the practical clockwork situation.
Keep actual anatomical ownership and normal reach; no new identity or age claim follows.
preserved_choices: The baseline uses the instant after winding, with key already removed.
Hand positions are agent-owned experimental staging, not requester-prescribed pose.
open_scope: Local hand contact, spacing, side placement and frame geometry may be refined to improve bodily plausibility and visibility.
contact_point.role_focus: An attendant just after winding a mechanical route table: one hand loosely holds a removed winding key beside the hip, the other palm rests on the outside frame, with connected arms and clear working space around the transmission.
contact_point.scene_context: One person stands next to a waist-high open-front machine. The important relation is contact and clearance, not a strenuous action or an added emotional archetype.

grounds.quote: The attendant holds the removed key beside her hip and rests the other palm on the outer frame, leaving the working structure visible.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The frozen baseline grounds the contact endpoints and single post-winding state. A source may offer only compatible local inspiration; it cannot supply source-owned anatomy, actual identity, or rewrite the reference-guidance property.

spatial_depth.reason: The little table marker and the actual boat must be read as distinct objects linked by the place.
spatial_depth.expressive_goal: Make the practical purpose of the instrument legible through foreground machine, attendant and landing beyond.
observable_targets: Attendant and full exposed route-table in one foreground attention plane
owner_relations: The marker is a component of the route-table.
The real boat occupies the canal beyond the pavilion rather than becoming a table miniature.
Columns and water give a continuous spatial route between instrument and journey.
required_constraints: Preserve face/hair reference guidance and practical Clockpunk in use.
Keep an identifiable human subject and useful machine together.
preserved_choices: Prefer the selected canal departure setting and real boat correspondence for this baseline experiment.
Keep the entire hanging-weight mechanism within the frame.
open_scope: Layering, overlap, negative space and local camera arrangement are authorial and may be refined.
Any change must preserve requester anchors and separately record its effect on this fixed experimental comparison.
spatial_depth.role_focus: An open canal departure pavilion with a reference-guided attendant and an exposed mechanical route table together in the foreground, an actual arriving boat at the landing visible beyond the columns, clear separation between the brass marker and real boat.
spatial_depth.scene_context: A restrained predawn travel photograph. The observer should understand why the attendant is watching the mechanism now by seeing the boat and landing in a coherent space.

grounds.quote: The route-table and approaching real boat share one pavilion-to-landing spatial relationship.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This role is depth ordering among already invented scene owners. It does not request a new world system, a different boat count as a hard lock, or narration invisible in a still image.
